Package ep.ui

Class UiTheme

java.lang.Object
ep.ui.UiTheme
public final class UiTheme extends Object
Colors, fonts and small drawing helpers shared by the calendar views. Fixed events are drawn as solid chips in the course color; study blocks use a pale tint of the same color with a dashed border so the two kinds are always distinguishable.
